purpose: Oedometer test beyond the data: a plane-strain block compressed between rigid frictionless walls follows the rank-one path F = I + (lambda-1) n (x) n, along which polyconvexity makes the load monotone. Tests whether the constrained and Unconstrained energies behave differently in a force-controlled finite element solve.
motivation: Material-point scan before this rule: along rank-one compression the Unconstrained energy has a load maximum of about 388 MPa for n along x and none for n along y down to lambda = 0.55; both constrained energies are monotone in every direction.
geometry: square block of side 10 mm, 8 x 8 cells of two quadratic triangles, plane strain, assembler thickness
boundary_conditions: x: left face u_x = 0, top and bottom faces u_y = 0, uniform compressive traction on the right face; y: bottom face u_y = 0, lateral faces u_x = 0, uniform compressive traction on the top face
newton: Full Newton with the consistent tangent, no line search and no step cutting; converged when the free residual is below 1e-5 N or 1e-7 of the first residual of the increment; at most 50 iterations; a failure ends the run.
outcomes: mean stretch of the loaded face
residual history of a failed increment
reporting: All 18 runs are kept whatever their outcome; nothing is rerun or tuned after execution. The paper reports this test only if it separates the two classes, and then reports all its runs.
environment: OMP_NUM_THREADS=MKL_NUM_THREADS=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1; torch threads 2; idle machine; serial runs
